coordinates: X across the panel; Y above the panel underside; Z along the panel, negative toward the printer exit (rear), positive toward Q0 (front). One scene unit is one millimetre. The wiring plan projects the same X/Z positions with rear at the top. Dimensions below are X × Y × Z unless noted.

parts.name: Hammond PCJ16148CC
parts.note: Factory Hammond STEP with project wall openings removed by exact CAD booleans. Dry indoor use only; the modified assembly has no claimed IP/NEMA certification. Four screw-fixed cover fasteners must be installed during operation.

parts.name: 14R1513 mounting panel
parts.note: Panel and fixing screws from the enclosure STEP assembly. The drawing gives 12.88 × 14.75 in and 0.075 in steel thickness. Electrical bonding is separate from the mounting screws.

parts.name: DENT ELITEpro XC
parts.note: Long blue body uses the current 216 × 63 × 47 mm specification. The older ELOG manual gives 203 × 69 × 58 mm. Measure the photographed instrument before finalizing. Ports, feet and grip details are visual approximations; plug space is additional. Adjustable two-strap mounting uses slots 82 mm apart; reserve a 216 × 69 × 58 mm acceptance envelope. No close-fitting cradle or drilling into the logger.

parts.name: CT1 · printer hot only
parts.note: DENT HSC mini hinged example, Ø10.2 mm aperture. Its catalog envelope illustrates the white split-core style in the photos; this does not identify your CT model or range. One hot conductor passes through once; arrow points toward output. Original full-resolution label shows CTHSC…U/B; range digits are physically obscured by leads, so the example remains unidentified.

parts.name: Q0 · single operating breaker
parts.note: Carling CA1-B0-24-615-121-DG. Mount directly against the inner front wall, with the handle nose through the manufacturer rectangle. Two #6-32 × 3/8 in screws and measured 0.8–1.0 mm flat washers; nominal engagement 3.75–3.95 mm into 4.95 mm inserts. Catalog torque: mounting 0.8–1.0 N·m; #10-32 studs 1.7–2.3 N·m. Outer screw-fixed enclosure guards terminals; unplug SUPPLY and verify dead before removing the cover. No separate speculative wall insert or live-service access.

parts.name: Fv · Littelfuse LPSC0001Z
parts.note: Non-indicating Class CC holder, 600 V AC/DC, 35 mm DIN rail. Catalog maximum 17.78 × 61 × 78.5 mm. Use 14 AWG Class C copper at both terminals (2.0 N·m); output runs to JV before the smaller blue pigtail. KLKR.500T (0.5 A) is a specific protection candidate, pending identification of the existing voltage leads. Reserve 120 mm above the holder for opening and replacement; actual door sweep to verify on receipt.

parts.name: JL / JN / JPE distribution
parts.note: Five WAGO 221-415 connectors in five 221-505 carriers: JL, JN, two bridged PE groups and JV (fuse-to-pigtail transition). Each carrier uses two M3 fasteners, lateral 20 mm spacing, at the front foot. Insert one conductor per port; strip 11 mm. Blue pigtail factory-tinned tips must not be assumed compatible without identification; use a manufacturer-approved preparation.

parts.name: XA · Leviton 5279-C flanged outlet
parts.note: 15 A, 125 V, NEMA 5-15R; direct panel mount. Rear body Ø42.8 × 43.6 mm; flange Ø63.5 mm. Project cutout Ø44.00 ±0.15 mm within manufacturer 43.66–44.45 mm; two mounting points 53.57 mm apart. No RACO box, separate cover or outlet-box PE conductor. XA ground contact still connects to PE. Torque 10–14 in-lb, copper conductors only. Rotate with actual wall draft during assembly; the website shows the conservative axis-aligned envelope.

parts.name: CUI SMI6-9-V-P5 · existing adapter
parts.note: Original label reads SMI6-9-V-P5: 9 V DC, 0.667 A, center positive. CUI SMI6 series drawing gives 64 ×40.5 ×30 mm, ±1 mm, excluding blades. P5: 5.5 ×2.1 ×9.5 mm barrel. Original cord retained; catalog UL2468 is flat, so round DC grommet fit remains open. Verify actual blade seating and do not suspend loads from the cord.

parts.name: Short DIN rail · Fv only
parts.note: DINnector DN-R35S1-2 cut to 100 mm, deburred. Two end stops. Drill two rail/backpanel fixing holes at X=-95 and -15, Z=-28. A dedicated #10 bond hole at X=-27, Z=-28 is transfer-drilled in the rail web only. Separate panel/rail PE hardware is specified in the fastener schedule.

parts.name: Long-thread power glands / KVT 32 split entries
parts.note: Two Hammond 1427NCGPG13LB: PG13.5, 15 mm thread, clamp 6–12 mm; drill Ø21.0 mm. Two icotek KVT 32 45026: M32 × 1.5, 14 mm thread, Ø32.3 mm opening, Ø40 flange / ~41 mm locknut. Gaskets and locknuts included. Select split KT inserts only after measuring round cable ODs; no cutting factory USB/DC connectors.

parts.name: Blue adapters & retained lead slack
parts.note: Three blue pigtails feed L1 hot, L2 neutral and N neutral. The visible coils reserve space for the full leads; they do not certify storage of each 2 m lead or minimum bend radius. Cable diameters, plug bodies and path lengths are estimates, not a cut list. The separate green conductor is PE. Coil scenario reserves 2 m flexible length per lead at an assumed 3 mm OD, with 4 mm pitch. This does not identify the actual lead length / OD or validate its bend radius, transitions or restraints.

plan.note: Shell bounds are the top-view envelope of enclosure.bin mesh 0; the mounting panel is mesh 33. The plan is a placement reference, not a fabrication template. Terminal symbols are separated for readable connectivity.

instances.label: Retained lead slack
instances.note: Scenario only: each full lead reserves 2000 mm of flexible cable, 3 mm assumed OD, 4 mm helix pitch and 28 mm between lead-layer starts. Actual lengths, diameters, bend limits and transitions must be measured.
